# TPC-Havoc Q13_v4

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpchavoc
```

> [TPC-Havoc](../../tpc-havoc.md) benchmark · [all TPC-Havoc queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
  c_count,
  SUM(custdist) AS custdist
FROM (
  SELECT
    c_count,
    COUNT(*) AS custdist
  FROM (
    SELECT
      c_custkey,
      COUNT(o_orderkey) AS c_count
    FROM customer
    LEFT OUTER JOIN orders
      ON c_custkey = o_custkey AND NOT o_comment LIKE '%special%requests%'
    WHERE
      c_custkey % 2 = 0
    GROUP BY
      c_custkey
  ) AS c_orders_even
  GROUP BY
    c_count
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    c_count,
    COUNT(*) AS custdist
  FROM (
    SELECT
      c_custkey,
      COUNT(o_orderkey) AS c_count
    FROM customer
    LEFT OUTER JOIN orders
      ON c_custkey = o_custkey AND NOT o_comment LIKE '%special%requests%'
    WHERE
      c_custkey % 2 = 1
    GROUP BY
      c_custkey
  ) AS c_orders_odd
  GROUP BY
    c_count
) AS combined
GROUP BY
  c_count
ORDER BY
  custdist DESC,
  c_count DESC
```
